## Context / Problem
`rebar --version` exits 1 with `Error: unknown subcommand '--version'` and the overview, and no rebar command prints the installed version. Release checks (and users filing bugs) need the version and build commit. Observed 2026-11-13 on origin/main d6ba771 in an editable build and in a wheel; v0.15.1 lacks it too, so this is not a regression.

Operator decision (2026-11-18, recorded in a ticket comment): option (1), a top-level `--version`, explicitly approved as an exception to the bug-fix no-new-flags rule.

## Approach
Serve `--version` in `rebar._cli._help_route.pre_scan` (src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py:162), the function that already serves `--help` and the unknown-subcommand error before any configuration, snapshot or store mount (`rebar._cli._main_dispatch` calls it first, src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:351). When the first residual token after the `-c` prefix is `--version`, write `rebar <version> (<commit>)` plus a newline to stdout and return 0.
- `<version>` is `importlib.metadata.version("nava-rebar")`; `unknown` on `PackageNotFoundError`.
- `<commit>` is `rebar._build_info.COMMIT`, read with the same dynamic import `_baked_commit_sha` uses (src/rebar/_signing_manifest.py:129, which returns None when `_build_info` is absent); `unknown` when absent or empty. The import is dynamic because `_build_info.py` is generated at build time and git-ignored.
Serving it in pre_scan fits because it is the one place top-level flags are answered without touching the store, so `rebar --version` works outside any tracker. Only the exact token `--version` is accepted (no `-V`), keeping the new surface to the one approved flag. The overview help text is unchanged.

## Scope
- src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py: `--version` branch in `pre_scan` and a small `_version_line()` helper.
- tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_argparse.py: new tests next to the unknown-subcommand tests.
- scripts/probe_rebar.py: assertions in the existing `--help` section (scripts/probe_rebar.py:564).
- .github/workflows/release.yml: `wheel_test` "Probe the installed wheel" step checks `rebar --version` output against the installed metadata and baked COMMIT.

## Testing
- Happy path: `main(["--version"])` returns 0, stdout equals `rebar <metadata version> (<COMMIT>)\n`, stderr empty.
- With a `-c SECTION.KEY=VALUE` prefix, `--version` is still served.
- Edge: `_build_info` missing (monkeypatched import failure) prints `(unknown)`; metadata missing prints `rebar unknown (...)`.
- Unknown subcommands still error (existing `frobnicate` test unchanged).
- Portability: pure Python, no subprocesses, paths, fds or signals; stdout text only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `rebar --version` exits 0 and prints `rebar <version> (<commit>)`. Checked: `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_argparse.py -k version` passes on merged main.
- [x] A wheel install prints the installed version. Checked: build a wheel from merged main with `python -m build --wheel`, install it into a fresh venv, run `rebar --version`, and confirm exit 0 and that the version matches `importlib.metadata.version("nava-rebar")` in that venv.
- [x] `scripts/probe_rebar.py` asserts `rebar --version` exits 0 and prints a line starting `rebar `. Checked: `python scripts/probe_rebar.py` reports FAIL 0 on merged main.
- [x] release.yml `wheel_test` probes `rebar --version`. Checked: reading the merged step, and `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
- [x] The operator's choice is recorded on this ticket. Checked: the 2026-11-18 decision comment.
